protocol.conditions_note: 9 sensitivities x {sigma 0.5 (primary), sigma 2.0 (robustness)} = 18 conditions x 50 plants. Keys: s0.50 ... (sigma 0.5), n2.0_s0.50 ... (sigma 2.0).

model_notes.H4_I1: I1 closed-loop early stopping: per-seed snapshot epoch chosen on plants 5250-5299: {'101': 300, '102': 600, '103': 600, '104': 900, '105': 600}
model_notes.H4_I2: I2: 10 inputs (DR-H4 inputs + one-parameter gain-RLS estimate g), best validation within 6000 epochs
model_notes.H4_I3: I3: DR-H4 retrained on open-loop + own closed-loop data, best validation within 6000 epochs
model_notes.H4_snap_*: raw DR-H4 weights at fixed epochs from the checkpointed retraining
model_notes.H4_I2_e*: raw I2 weights at fixed epochs

statistics.unit: plant; network arms averaged over five seeds within plant

analysis.high_gain_definition: sweep sensitivities at or above nominal s = 1.0 (1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.4), fixed before confirmation

Q1.test: fraction of the full-RLS mean improvement over fixed ARX recovered by ARX_gain: ratio of plant-level means of (fixed - gain) and (fixed - full), each averaged over the 9 sensitivities at sigma 0.5

Q3.test: H4_10k - H4_I2: per-plant mean over the high-gain set at sigma 0.5

Q4.name: differential training-length effect
Q4.test: D = [H4_snap_e6000 - H4_snap_e900] - [H4_I2_e6000 - H4_I2_e900]: per-plant mean over the high-gain set at sigma 0.5
Q4.decision: BCa lower bound > 0 (supports a differential effect only; opposite directions are tested separately in S_Q4dir)
Q4.checkpoint_rule: fixed epochs 900 and 6000 for both networks; no checkpoint chosen on confirmation plants

analysis.note_on_primary_multiplicity: Q1, Q3, Q4 are three distinct questions, each tested at its own 95% level; not combined.

S_Q2.test: per plant: Spearman(g summary, s) across the 9 sensitivities at sigma 0.5; mean over plants
S_Q2.caveat: rank correlation checks ordering only, not accuracy

S_calibration.test: per-plant linear fit g = a s + b: slope, intercept, mean |residual|; g at s 1.0 minus 1; CV of g/s

S_Q4dir.test: opposite directions: plain e6000-e900 > 0 AND gain-input e6000-e900 < 0 (high-gain means)

S_Q3_per_setting.test: H4_10k - H4_I2 at each high-gain setting

S1.test: H4_I2 - ARX_RLS (paired differences, no equivalence claim)

S4.test: slope of network dyhat/du vs s / slope of 60*g*w_u vs s, for H4_10k, H4_900, H4_I2

S5.test: mean RMSE per arm and condition (both noise levels)

R.test: Q1, Q3, Q4 statistics recomputed at sigma 2.0 with identical definitions

gain_estimator.definition: scalar RLS on g with prediction = prior non-action terms + g * prior action terms (u, u-1..u-4); lambda 0.98, P0 1000, g0 = 1; updated after every step with the applied action; identical in ARX_gain and as the H4_I2 input; same construction at both noise levels
gain_estimator.prior: OLS ARX-10 prior fitted on training plants 2000-2099 (hash in arx_prior)

protocol.intended_claim_if_supported: Explicit online estimation of a low-dimensional hidden plant parameter can substantially improve learned closed-loop control, and may explain part of the gap between history-based neural predictors and adaptive linear models (synthetic plant only).
prohibitions: No tuning or model selection on 8000-8049
No change of hypotheses, thresholds or alpha after FROZEN

S_calibration.note: g is a multiplier on the prior's action terms; g = 1 means the prior gain. Its absolute scale is defined relative to the domain-randomised prior, not to s itself.

secondary.note: secondary and robustness results are reported with their stated levels; they do not change primary decisions
